integrity: Explicit proof plus standalone standard-library checks. Verification of an unbounded statement is mathematical, not exhaustive computational. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Two named colors; only distance-two rainbow routes on crown graphs, not full 2-color rainbow connectivity, which is impossible owing to distance-three pairs. No nonoptimal count or general bipartite classification is given. Priority may overlap unindexed matrix-separation variants.
title: Sparse rainbow two-step colorings of crown graphs and the no-short-cycle permutation law
